$comment: Machine-readable provenance for the CSD Lean corpus (CONVENTIONS.md §8.2).
SEEDED 2026-07-31, NOT COMPLETE: this file was created to carry the Lean-QIT
citation and currently holds only the entries that already have a concrete
consumer. The §8.2 obligation -- one entry per source, plus line-precise
[Key, file:Lstart-Lend] citations in every module docstring -- remains OPEN in
specs/BACKLOG.md. Do not read the size of this file as the corpus's citation
coverage; read it as the start of that migration.
Keys are stable citation handles used from module docstrings.

references.title: Lean-QIT: quantum information theory in Lean 4

relevant_declarations.name: relativeEntropy_dataProcessing_channel_ge
relevant_declarations.why: Data-processing inequality for quantum relative entropy -- the upstream discharge of this corpus's `hDPI` hypothesis.

relevant_declarations.name: condMutualInfo_nonneg
relevant_declarations.why: Non-negativity of conditional mutual information, i.e. strong subadditivity.

references.status: CITED, NOT IMPORTED. Lake resolves one version per dependency and the toolchains differ (Lean v4.30.0 / Mathlib tag v4.30.0 upstream, vs v4.33.0-rc1 / Mathlib master c732b96d here), so no dependency edge exists. This corpus's SSA therefore REMAINS CONDITIONAL on `hDPI`. The citation records where the wall is climbed; it does not climb it here.
references.planned_use: A separate `csd-qit-bridge` package depending on both projects BY TAG, holding the Matrix<->State adapter, discharging `hDPI`, and exporting unconditional SSA. Neither project merges into the other; CsdLean4 keeps its Mathlib-only dependency footprint.

references.title: Quantum States and Generalized Observables: A Simple Proof of Gleason's Theorem
references.status: The effect-Gleason result this corpus PROVES independently as `OperationalPackage.effect_gleason_representation` (2026-07-21), which deleted the last `axiom`. Cited as the source of the statement, not of the proof.
